# Embedded Emissions: Not Computed

**Reason:** The CN code is missing, which is a required input.

The ruleset says the default SEE is selected jointly by (CN code, country). If any required input is missing, no estimate may be made.

| Required input | Status |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | ❌ **Missing.** The description doesn't settle the heading. |
| (b) Country of production | ✅ India (listed for all goods in the table) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 600 t |

## Why the description isn't enough

"Semi-finished steel product, continuously cast, carbon ~0.2%" plausibly matches more than one row for India, and the SEE values differ:

| CN code | Table description (truncated) | SEE, India (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel, contai... | 4.32 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap... | 2.64 |

The table descriptions are truncated, so I can't verify the full criteria, such as the carbon threshold or cross-section, against the datasheet. Choosing one would mean guessing at classification. That guess would change the result by about 64%, and the ruleset forbids it.

## What's needed to finish

Please provide the **declared CN code** for this good, for example from the customs declaration or supplier documentation. Once it's confirmed:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN code, India) × 600 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
